system.description:
Cold-Hearted? Poisonous? Hissing through a forked tongue? Show your detractors exactly what you think of their ugly comments.

Toxic Spit

(1/encounter) Action: Spit an adjacent foe in the face. 1d4 Poison. On hit: Blinded until the end of their next turn. [M]

Nim+ Volume I — submitted by SanityWithIn.
